competency_statement_fil: TESDA BHS NC II common competency — Implement and monitor infection control policies and procedures: natutukoy ng BHW ang posibleng daan ng pagkalat nang walang diagnosis, nakapagmumungkahi ng magkakaugnay na kontrol na may tamang responsable, naipapakita ang wastong paglilinis ng kamay at pag-ubo, natutulungan ang pamilya sa mas ligtas na pagkain, tubig at sanitasyon, at naitatala ang patakaran, training gap at IPC gap ng BHS hanggang sa may ebidensiya ng follow-up.
competency_statement_en: TESDA BHS NC II common competency — Implement and monitor infection control policies and procedures: the BHW identifies possible transmission routes without diagnosing anyone, proposes layered controls with appropriate owners, demonstrates correct hand hygiene and cough etiquette, helps a household toward safer food, water and sanitation, and records BHS policies, training gaps and IPC gaps through to follow-up evidence.

observation_indicators.observable_fil: Naipapaliwanag ang walong card, naihihiwalay ang exposure sa diagnosis at naiuugnay ang pag-iwas sa tamang daan.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Explains all eight cards, distinguishes exposure from diagnosis and links prevention to the route.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Nagbibigay ng diagnosis mula sa hitsura o ipinapalagay na lahat ng mikrobyo ay dumaraan sa parehong paraan.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Diagnoses from appearance or assumes every germ spreads in the same way.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Tama ang walong pag-uugnay; walang bansag o diagnosis at may angkop na kontrol nang walang paalala.
levels.kaya_na_en: Matches all eight cards appropriately, without labels or diagnosis, and suggests suitable controls without prompting.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Karamihan ay tama pero kailangang linawin ang contact at paglanghap; naitatama matapos ang feedback.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Most matches are appropriate, but contact and inhalation need clarification; corrects them after feedback.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Nagbibigay ng diagnosis mula sa hitsura o ipinapalagay na lahat ng mikrobyo ay dumaraan sa parehong paraan.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Diagnoses from appearance or assumes every germ spreads in the same way.

observation_indicators.observable_fil: May kontrol sa apat na uri, malinaw na responsable at walang sariling pagbabago sa clinical o engineering na proseso.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Includes all four types, appropriate owners and no unauthorized clinical or engineering changes.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Mask lamang ang sagot o binabago ang isolation arrangement nang walang gabay.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Relies only on a mask or changes isolation arrangements without guidance.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Magkakaugnay ang apat na kontrol at malinaw ang dapat ipasuri nang walang paalala.
levels.kaya_na_en: Links all four controls and identifies what needs review without prompting.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: May maraming kontrol pero kailangang paalalahanang magtalaga ng responsable.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Suggests several controls but needs a prompt to assign owners.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Mask lamang ang sagot o binabago ang isolation arrangement nang walang gabay.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Relies only on a mask or changes isolation arrangements without guidance.

observation_indicators.observable_fil: Tamang paraan; lahat ng bahagi ng magkabilang kamay; kumpletong oras at pagpapatuyo; walang muling kontaminasyon.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Appropriate method; all surfaces of both hands; complete timing and drying; no recontamination.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Handrub ang ginagamit sa may dumi, iniiwan ang mahahalagang bahagi o pinupunasan ang basang handrub.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Uses handrub on visibly dirty hands, misses essential surfaces or wipes off wet handrub.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Kumpleto ang dalawang demonstration at lahat ng hakbang sa checklist nang walang paalala.
levels.kaya_na_en: Completes both demonstrations and every checklist step without prompting.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Tama ang paraan pero may nakaligtaang bahagi o hakbang; naitatama sa muling demonstration.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Chooses the correct method but misses a surface or step; corrects it in a repeat demonstration.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Handrub ang ginagamit sa may dumi, iniiwan ang mahahalagang bahagi o pinupunasan ang basang handrub.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Uses handrub on visibly dirty hands, misses essential surfaces or wipes off wet handrub.

observation_indicators.observable_fil: Natatakpan ang ilong at bibig, naitatapon ang tissue, nalilinis ang kamay at naipapaliwanag ang magalang na pag-uulat.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Covers nose and mouth, discards tissue, cleans hands and explains respectful reporting.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Sa palad o kapareha umuubo, ginagamit muli ang tissue o nilalaktawan ang hand hygiene.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Coughs into hands or toward a partner, reuses tissue or omits hand hygiene.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Kumpleto ang dalawang paraan at follow-through nang walang palad, exposure sa kapareha o paalala.
levels.kaya_na_en: Completes both methods and follow-through without using hands to cover, exposing a partner or needing prompts.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Tama ang pagtakip pero kailangan ng paalala sa hand hygiene o pag-uulat.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Covers correctly but needs a prompt for hand hygiene or reporting.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Sa palad o kapareha umuubo, ginagamit muli ang tissue o nilalaktawan ang hand hygiene.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Coughs into hands or toward a partner, reuses tissue or omits hand hygiene.

observation_indicators.observable_fil: May angkop na pagbabago sa pagkain, tubig at sanitasyon; walang hinulaang treatment o garantiya mula sa hitsura.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Proposes appropriate food, water and sanitation changes without guessed treatment or appearance-based guarantees.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Ginagarantiyang ligtas ang malinaw na tubig o nanghuhula ng dami ng kemikal.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Guarantees that clear water is safe or guesses chemical amounts.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Kumpleto ang tatlong hanay at malinaw ang ipapakumpirma sa health o water staff nang walang paalala.
levels.kaya_na_en: Completes all three rows and identifies what health or water staff must confirm without prompting.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: May angkop na pagbabago pero kailangan ng paalala sa pagprotekta ng tubig o contact para sa treatment.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Suggests appropriate changes but needs a prompt on water protection or the treatment contact.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Ginagarantiyang ligtas ang malinaw na tubig o nanghuhula ng dami ng kemikal.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Guarantees that clear water is safe or guesses chemical amounts.

observation_indicators.observable_fil: Naipapakita ang lokasyon, bersiyon, contact at training gaps nang walang imbentong training o awtorisasyon.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Records location, version, contact and training gaps without inventing training or authorization.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Itinuturing na awtorisasyon ang nabasang policy o minamarkahang trained ang hindi naobserbahan.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Treats reading a policy as authorization or marks unobserved training as completed.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Kumpleto ang mga hanay, malinaw ang kukumpirma at naihihiwalay ang specialist na gawain nang walang paalala.
levels.kaya_na_en: Completes the rows, names who confirms them and distinguishes specialist tasks without prompting.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: May lokasyon at contact pero kailangang idagdag ang bersiyon o training gap matapos ang paalala.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Records location and contact but adds version or training gaps only after prompting.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Itinuturing na awtorisasyon ang nabasang policy o minamarkahang trained ang hindi naobserbahan.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Treats reading a policy as authorization or marks unobserved training as completed.

observation_indicators.observable_fil: May tiyak na gap, pag-uulat, responsable, petsa at ebidensiya; naihihiwalay ang pangako sa naobserbahang resulta.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Records a specific gap, report, owner, date and evidence; distinguishes promises from observed results.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Minamarkahang tapos ang hindi pa naayos o ipinapalagay na competent ang lahat mula sa attendance.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Marks unresolved work complete or assumes everyone is competent from attendance.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Kumpleto ang card, tapat ang resolved at unresolved na resulta, at may susunod na aksyon nang walang paalala.
levels.kaya_na_en: Completes the card with accurate resolved and unresolved outcomes and next actions without prompting.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Malinaw ang gap pero kailangang paalalahanang magtakda ng follow-up o ebidensiya.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: States the gap clearly but needs a prompt to set follow-up or evidence.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Minamarkahang tapos ang hindi pa naayos o ipinapalagay na competent ang lahat mula sa attendance.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Marks unresolved work complete or assumes everyone is competent from attendance.
